company.shortDescription: Tributi is a Colombian fintech start-up backed by Y Combinator.
company.description: Tributi is a Colombian fintech start-up backed by Y Combinator. It is drastically reducing tax compliance friction for individuals in Latin America by automating tax filing preparation.

productsAndServices.description: A digital service that helps individuals in Colombia prepare and submit their annual income tax declaration to the DIAN, ensuring compliance with local tax laws.
productsAndServices.name: Tax Declaration for Natural Persons 2025

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based application that guides users step-by-step to complete their tax declaration, import data from DIAN, and submit it electronically with expert support available.
productsAndServices.name: Tributi App

productsAndServices.description: A service where a tax expert prepares, reviews, and submits the user's income tax declaration, providing personalized assistance via WhatsApp or video call.
productsAndServices.name: Expert Tax Declaration Service

productsAndServices.description: A package designed for companies to provide their employees with access to Tributi's tax declaration services, including communication support and error liability coverage.
productsAndServices.name: Corporate Employee Tax Declaration Package

productsAndServices.description: Online tools that help users determine if they must file income tax and assess their fiscal residency status in Colombia.
productsAndServices.name: Tax Obligation and Residency Fiscal Status Tools

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,437,917 to $9,570,981, a 6.66x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 19 (-30 over 90 days) and market heat at 39 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
